organizing_principle: Shared task and evidence contracts; role-specific projections; no duplicated identity, inventory, route, trust, service lifecycle, or payment authority.

roles.purpose: Make day-to-day decisions and coordinate work without needing constant connectivity or expert-level software skills.
key_tasks: compare a repair quote or available alternatives
critical_risks: mistaking a request or provider completion for an accepted service
exposing exact location or commercial data

roles.purpose: Manage heterogeneous operations without forcing crop-centric assumptions onto animals, feed, water, and veterinary support.
key_tasks: record livestock observation with time and provenance
request qualified veterinary or livestock-extension support
retain animal-health uncertainty and escalation paths
critical_risks: presenting advisory output as a veterinary diagnosis
delaying urgent human or veterinary care

roles.purpose: Support evidence-backed field visits and follow-up while preserving farmer agency and clearly separating reported from personally observed facts.
key_tasks: record direct observations separately from farmer reports
provide sourced advice with assumptions and limits
track whether a recommendation was tried and what happened
critical_risks: confusing model-generated text with expert-approved advice

roles.purpose: Receive, quote, schedule, execute, and document pump/pipe/irrigation service work with clear scope and acceptance.
key_tasks: record work performed and parts used
respond to acceptance, complaint, or rework

roles.purpose: Coordinate shared machinery, operators, maintenance, and field-service windows while making capacity and route evidence explicit.
key_tasks: review verified route legs and deadlines
record breakdown, maintenance, parts delay and recovery
report service completion for customer decision
critical_risks: using straight-line distance as travel time
optimizing utilization while excluding remote or smaller farms
treating a schedule as completed work

roles.purpose: Coordinate members, planned and observed supply, typed products, orders, pickup/delivery, shortages and disputes.
key_tasks: maintain product profiles with explicit units
separate planned yield from current stock
record handoff, shortage, spoilage or recall
critical_risks: exposing farm or household locations unnecessarily
credential mistaken for food-safety or regulatory approval

roles.purpose: Maintain solar, electrical, storage and pumping equipment using safe work records and explicit qualification boundaries.
key_tasks: triage a fault using qualified procedures
critical_risks: commissioning mistaken for proof of long-term safety

roles.purpose: Coordinate inspection-backed repair and retrofit work packages, materials, labor, change orders and accepted delivery.
key_tasks: estimate quantities, labor, timing and materials
critical_risks: simulated design mistaken for structural or code approval
billable completion mistaken for acceptable quality

roles.purpose: Coordinate collection, sorting, reuse, repair and lawful transfer of materials with auditable quantities and destinations.
key_tasks: weigh or count material with declared units
connect recoverable material with authorized reuse or processing
critical_risks: counting collected material as recovered material

prioritization_rule: P0 roles validate the shared decision-to-outcome loop. P1 adds food and machinery operations that reuse it. P2 adds other maintenance/construction roles after safe work and capability contracts exist. P3 follows only when traceability and buyer/destination evidence are defined.
non_goals: automatic diagnosis, procurement, payment, physical actuation or regulatory decision
role-based access treated as permission to expose all farmer data
